snippet.title: Adorable Adventures - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description: Watch the Demo Trailer for Adorable Adventures, a cozy third-person adventure exploration game developed by Wild Sheep Studio. Players will step into the role of Boris, a young baby boar, making sense of the great big world and all of its environments. Explore peaceful forest meadows, rocky highlands, dark caves, and more to make friends, reveal long-kept secrets, and more. Adorable Adventures is coming soon to PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) with a demo available now.
